events.line: Arben really said "let me start the guy who literally didn't touch the field" and somehow managed to be wrong about the one thing that was actually guaranteed to happen—JT getting absolutely nothing. What the fuck was that start, dude?

Rob, I genuinely didn't know it was possible to get skunked this hard by a starting QB in 2024—congrats on finding the one week Marcus Mariota decided to audition for a European soccer league instead of throwing a football.
Rinor really said "nah, I don't need 14 points from my bench this week" – enjoy watching DK's monster game from the sidelines while your starter probably put up 6 fucking points.
Faton really said "Josh Downs is my guy" and watched him put up a fat fucking zero while projections promised 11, what a goddamn disaster.
Ilir really said "let me start a guy projected for double digits" and watched him put up a fucking tenth of a point—that's not a start, that's a cry for help.
Tyler Warren put up a fat fuckin' goose egg when he was supposed to get you 10 points, and you STARTED him—that's what happens when you panic-start a tight end who hasn't done shit all season.

Adam, you absolute madman—Judkins just shit on his projection like he had something to prove, and somehow you're still the genius who started him when everyone else was sleeping on that backfield committee!
Antonio Williams put up a fat fucking zero and Adam still had the stones to start him—that's what happens when you draft like you're playing a slot machine instead of doing five minutes of research.
